::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1892/3?]  
**Manuscript:** MS Miss Sarah Jardine-Willoughby
:::

Dear Sir
I have consulting [sic] my [colleague](people/person_329.qmd) as to whether she remembers having your daughter's little book  She does not remember it, and I believe I had it, but did not think it came within scope of the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd), and we have very little room for notices of books, so as only to be able to put in what bears on our purpose

yours truly
C M Yonge
